balance.note: metres walked from the castle's door by the shortest route over the ground (50 cm cells, steps of at most 50 cm, no water, no building; trees and fences not counted)

buildable_m2.note: square metres of level ground a side can walk to and is nearer to than its foe, less roads, buildings, plots and paddocks. meadow: the flat open ground round its buildings; open: no tree within 4 m; wooded: under trees (a building clears them)
